_comment: The outside tools whose versions change the numbers, and the single place
the pinned ones are written down. action.yml installs exactly these, and
engine-version.js hashes this file as part of the engine's identity.
They live inside the engine directory rather than beside the install step
for two reasons. The versions ARE part of the measurement — change one and
you have changed the ruler, so a score's identity has to cover them. And
the engine may not read anything above its own directory, which is what
makes it extractable at all; reaching up to action.yml for these would
break that boundary rather than respect it.
Treat a bump as a scoring change: re-scan everything and compare. Replaying
a previous run's committed reports through the new engine offline is the
cheap way to tell an inert change from a real one.
NOT EVERYTHING HERE IS PINNED — see `floating` below, and read it before
trusting two runs to be comparable.
_floating_comment: Three tools that produce scores resolve at run time, so two watchtowers on
the same engine tag can measure differently on different days. This is not
a decision, it is an omission found on 2026-08-20 while making a score able
to name its own ruler — and it is the one thing the digest cannot capture,
because the version is not known until the run happens.
Affected measurements: Ruby complexity (rubocop), Elixir complexity (credo)
Left floating deliberately for now rather than fixed in passing: choosing a
version is a scoring change and wants its own re-scan and comparison.
